tactics.hint.mentality.veryDefensive: Sit very deep and hold on. You'll concede far less, but there's almost no attacking threat.
tactics.hint.mentality.defensive: Weighted towards defence. Useful when the underdog faces a stronger side.
tactics.hint.mentality.balanced: Strikes a balance between attack and defence.
tactics.hint.mentality.attacking: More players join the attack. Expect more goals at both ends.
tactics.hint.mentality.veryAttacking: Throw everything forward for a goal. Leaves big gaps in behind.
tactics.hint.pressing.low: Drop off and close the space. Saves energy and cards, but you'll see less of the ball.
tactics.hint.pressing.high: Win the ball high up the pitch. More clear-cut chances, but players tire faster and pick up more cards.
tactics.hint.style.short: Keep the ball with short passing and work quality chances. Fewer shots overall.
tactics.hint.style.mixed: Mix it up depending on the situation.
tactics.hint.style.direct: Get it forward quickly. More shots, but you'll give up possession.
